newsitem.title: POLAND: Novita sees PLN 4.2 mln net in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Novita sees PLN 4.2 mln net in 1996.

text.p: Polish carpet maker Novita SA, after investing 25 million zlotys in 1994 and 1995, expects a 4.2-million-zloty net profit this year despite a dismal first half, the firm's president told the daily Gazeta Wyborcza.

Marek Gorny said earnings should rise by another 25 percent in 1997. Novita earned 0.03 million zlotys in this year's first half versus 1.01 million in the same period last year. It earned 1.6 million zlotys last year.
Gorny said the 25 million zlotys went toward production technology and to expanding the firm's Novita Market sales network of 30 outlets throughout Poland.
He said sales normally pick up in August when the firm records 75 percent of its technical carpet sales.
Gorny also said that this year Novita would sell one million square metres of carpeting to the U.S.'s Armstrong, which might buy a minority share of Novita Market.
"Talks are already underway and we're negotiating with other potential investors, including Polish ones, though nothing concrete has yet been established," Wyborcza quoted Marek Gorny as saying.
